artworks.title: The Placeholder Isles
artworks.statement: A chart of islands that don't exist. Watch the ship: it sails while the compass needle swings and cloud shadows cross the sea.

artworks.title: Lantern Harbour
artworks.statement: A harbour after dark. A boat crosses the water and fireworks open beside the moon.

artworks.title: Garden Study No. 3
artworks.statement: A hedge in full bloom. Watch the butterflies move from flower to flower.
